Missing antecedent instructions and successor interpretation prevent decisive classification. All six must remain ordinary ambiguous-boundary mappings, with specific uncertainties in the existing classification_basis and boundary_adjudication. A possible successfully held exemplar is an explanation, not a fourth role or subtype.

A later omission alone proves neither validation nor erasure. Reported provider interpretation is considered but not substituted for VIGIL's class decision.
